title: Approval history
description: Past approvals/rejections with actor, timestamp, reason. Filterable.
definitionOfDone: Table: action (approved/rejected badge), actor, timestamp, job reference, reason/comment
Filter by action type and time range
Click row navigates to job detail

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/approvals/ApprovalHistory.tsx: History tab/section on approvals page. Uses useApprovalHistory(filters). Table: action column (approved=success badge, rejected=danger badge), actor (username), timestamp (formatted), job reference (link to /jobs/:id), reason/comment text. Filter bar: action type (approved/rejected/all), time range (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d). Pagination controls.
implementationPlan.note: Created ApprovalHistory component with: table (action badge, actor, timestamp, job link, reason/comment), filter bar (action type: all/approved/rejected; time range: 1h/24h/7d/30d), pagination controls, loading skeleton, error and empty states. Uses useApprovalHistory hook. Click job reference navigates to /jobs/:id.

implementationPlan.description: Integrate ApprovalHistory as 'History' tab in ApprovalsPage.tsx (tab toggle: Pending / History).
implementationPlan.note: Added Pending/History tab toggle to ApprovalsPage. History tab renders ApprovalHistory component. Pending tab retains existing approval cards + detail modal. Tab styling matches packs page pattern (pill-style toggle).
tsc --noEmit passes clean for all approval-related files.
